race.title: Matchbook Betting Exchange Craddockstown Novice Chase (Grade 2)
race.verdict: LOVELY HURLING has made a promising start over fences, closing all the way to the line when runner-up in a Grade 3 novice at Navan in February, and he could be ready to go one better on his return. Stablemate Zanoosh appeals as a noteworthy recruit to chasing and is feared most, ahead of Kainsbourg . LOVELY HURLING (IRE) ZANOOSH (IRE) KAINSBOURG (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Zanoosh (2/1), Lovely Hurling (9/4), Ocastle Des Mottes (3/1), Frankie John (11/2), Kainsbourg (10/1), Soir De Garde (66/1)
